name: Conditional Antimatroids
summary: One-inclusion graphs of finite intersection-closed families containing the empty set in which every member is generated by its extremal elements, considered up to cube symmetries and suppression of constants.
comments: A conditional antimatroid need not contain its whole ground set. If it does, it is a convex geometry. This class is larger than the ideals of convex geometries; the latter are a special kind of bouquet.
